description: Extract current Killroy account state, run upgrades, permanent bonuses, canonical monster records, damage, and shop gates for the regular save.

extractions.label: killroy_account_state
extractions.description: Named native saved state. Third weekly fight uses its own unlock flag, not Jade Gain progression. Consumed fight slots encode one-based slot numbers as decimal digits.

extractions.label: killroy_run_state
extractions.description: Current timer and all six run upgrade gates from native saved operands and version 1.24 source 194324–194337 and 194566–194568. The timer adds its level to 100 seconds. Shades of K permits round(3 + level) choices. Each offered upgrade also requires (2*index)^min(index,2) completed runs, except upgrade zero. Remaining runs measures only the completed-run deficit; reaching zero does not bypass the choice gate.

extractions.label: killroy_monster_records
extractions.description: Every canonical Death Note monster and its Killroy best, including zero records. Excludes unrelated saved record keys.

extractions.label: killroy_total_best_kills
extractions.description: Native canonical aggregate of monster bests. This is not the sum of every saved record or lifetime room kills.

extractions.label: killroy_damage_bonus
extractions.description: Native Rift Killroy damage bonus in percentage points.

extractions.label: killroy_damage_multiplier
extractions.description: Applied version 1.24 damage multiplier: one plus native damage percentage divided by 100, with that contribution clamped between zero and two.

extractions.label: killroy_next_damage_requirement
extractions.description: Independent inverse of the native floor(total^0.4) percentage rule, using native damage and canonical saved bests. No separate native next-requirement helper exists. This targets the next raw percentage point, not a change to the capped applied multiplier.

extractions.label: killroy_bonus_0
extractions.description: Current native Artifact Find Chance multiplier.

extractions.label: killroy_bonus_1
extractions.description: Current native Crop Evolution Chance multiplier.

extractions.label: killroy_bonus_3
extractions.description: Current native Gallery progression value, before consumer-specific podium caps.

extractions.label: killroy_bonus_4
extractions.description: Current native Masterclass drop shop value, distinct from its applied multiplier.

extractions.label: killroy_bonus_5
extractions.description: Current native World 7 skill EXP multiplier. Version 1.24 Research and Spelunking use max(1, output) directly, not one plus output divided by 100.

extractions.label: killroy_bonus_6
extractions.description: Current native daily coral gain percentage points.

extractions.label: killroy_bonus_7
extractions.description: Current native future bonus shop value. No gameplay consumer is established.

extractions.label: killroy_masterclass_multiplier
extractions.description: Applied Masterclass drop multiplier. Version 1.24 AllMasterclassDropz applies one plus the native shop value divided by 100.

extractions.label: killroy_extra_shop_row
extractions.description: Native first extra Skull Shop row gate from Rift progress. This does not unlock the third weekly fight.

extractions.label: killroy_later_shop_row
extractions.description: Native later Skull Shop row gate from Rift progress and saved later-shop progression.
